div.div: Oregon draws BPA hydro. Arizona or Nevada draws solar plus storage. Power capacity sets the fleet ceiling.

div.div:
Observability
Operators track time to first token, time per output token, goodput per accelerator, cache hit rate, and errors per tenant. Alerts fire on SLO burn rate.
Tools: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DCGM

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 179, 0), rgb(143, 78, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 262px; height: 1px; padding-top: 460px; margin-left: 1436px;

div.div:
Model Release Pipeline
Each model version passes evals, safety review, and load tests. It ships to 1% of traffic, then expands while checks pass. Rollback swaps the weights pointer.
Tools: NeMo Evaluator, NeMo Customizer

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 179, 0), rgb(143, 78, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 262px; height: 1px; padding-top: 800px; margin-left: 1436px;

div.div:
Security
Data stays encrypted in transit and at rest. Zero retention tenants get no prompt logging. Tenants never share KV cache. Model weights sit behind tight access control.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 179, 0), rgb(143, 78, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 262px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1120px; margin-left: 1436px;

div.div:
West Coast Sites
Oregon primary carries 60% of traffic. Arizona or Nevada secondary carries 40%. Edge PoPs sit in LA, the Bay Area, and Seattle. Overflow spills to central US.
Sizing: about 600 nodes, 4,800 accelerators, 6 MW.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 552px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1490px; margin-left: 166px;

div.div:
Open path (hardware neutral)
Kubernetes runs the llm-d scheduler, which feeds vLLM prefill and decode pods. LMCache and NIXL move KV cache. The pods run on TPU, Trainium, Gaudi, AMD, or NVIDIA.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 652px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1490px; margin-left: 746px;

div.div:
NVIDIA path (single vendor)
NIM packages the model. The Dynamo Smart Router feeds TensorRT-LLM engines. The Dynamo KV Block Manager and NIXL move KV cache over NVLink and InfiniBand. NeMo Guardrails screens content.

The tiers run A, C, C, H, I: Access, Control, Compute software, Hardware, Infrastructure.
